title: A turn towards a real choice
meaning: Your conversation can turn with circumstances, revealing an actual choice beneath an earlier assumption of agreement.
text: A decision for two sometimes begins with “Do you actually want this?” The Lovers in the physical position of Vishuddha suggest speaking with respect for each person's free choice rather than substituting silent agreement. The Wheel of Fortune in energy brings conversation alive through new circumstances: changed plans become a constructive opportunity to hear each other more accurately. The Tower in emotions shows the abruptness of that clarification when earlier agreement proves to rest on different pictures. Even a small subject can produce a powerful surprise.

For example, an unexpectedly free evening leads to a suggestion of inviting guests. You discover that each had assumed the other loved such gatherings. The new circumstance finally makes room for your own wishes. **A turn in plans can reveal a choice that had remained unspoken.** You can rebuild the evening around real answers. The surprise belongs to an earlier assumption and need not overshadow the possibility of finding a suitable option now.

The difficulty comes if, after the discovery, you seek immediate final agreement to make everything understandable again. The other person needs time to process what was heard while questions are already moving ahead. Shared choice begins to feel cramped. A small interval between the broken assumption and a new arrangement gives each person time to accept that arrangement freely.
